# ctables/continue

> `continue`: jumps to the `next` block of the innermost loop.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/continue.pkg) · translates [std/continue](../std/continue.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
goto {loop.L.next};
```
